stories.headline: Anthropic in early talks with Samsung to manufacture its own custom AI chip

key_facts.fact: The Information reported on July 2 that Anthropic has begun early-stage development of a custom AI server chip and is in preliminary talks with Samsung to manufacture it.
key_facts.excerpt: On Thursday, The Information reported that Anthropic was in contact with Samsung to explore a collaboration around the pending chip. However, Anthropic hasn't yet decided what the chip will be used for, how it will fit into the server, or how powerful it will be.

key_facts.fact: Anthropic is evaluating Samsung Foundry's 2-nanometer manufacturing process and advanced packaging capabilities for the proprietary processor.
key_facts.excerpt: The Information reported Thursday that the US AI model developer is considering using Samsung's 2-nanometer foundry process and advanced packaging facilities to manufacture its own high-end chips.

key_facts.fact: The project remains at an early stage with the chip's architecture, performance and server-deployment strategy undetermined, detailed design work not begun, and Anthropic still talking to multiple chip-design firms.
key_facts.excerpt: The project remains at an early stage, with the chip's architecture, performance specifications and server deployment strategy yet to be determined, while detailed design work has not begun.

key_facts.fact: Anthropic recently hired Clive Chan, an early member of OpenAI's custom-chip team, signaling a move from exploration toward active development.
key_facts.excerpt: What has changed since April is that Anthropic has hired Clive Chan, who previously helped build OpenAI's custom chip programme, a signal that the company is moving from exploration to active development.

key_facts.fact: Anthropic told TechCrunch that a diversified hardware stack including chips from Google, Amazon and Nvidia will continue to be central to its compute strategy.
key_facts.excerpt: Anthropic told TechCrunch that a diversified hardware stack that includes chips from Google, Amazon, and Nvidia will continue to be pivotal to its compute strategy.

key_facts.fact: A deal would be a marquee foundry customer win for Samsung as it tries to narrow the gap with TSMC in advanced logic chips; OpenAI last week unveiled its first in-house inference processor, Jalapeno, developed with Broadcom.
key_facts.excerpt: OpenAI last week unveiled its first in-house inference processor, Jalapeno, developed with Broadcom, while Alphabet, Amazon, Meta and Microsoft are all expanding development of their own AI chips.

stories.headline: AI data center builder Crusoe in talks to raise $3B at a ~$30B valuation

key_facts.fact: Crusoe is in active talks to raise about $3 billion in a round that would value the company around the $30 billion range including the new investment, up from about $10 billion in October.
key_facts.excerpt: Investors expect the value to fall within the $30 billion range, including the new investments... The company was valued at about $10 billion in October.

key_facts.fact: Crusoe raised $1.38 billion in a Series E round last year at more than a $10 billion valuation, co-led by Valor Equity Partners and Mubadala Capital.
key_facts.excerpt: Last year, Crusoe raised $1.38 billion in a Series E round at more than a $10 billion valuation. The round was co-led by technology investors Valor Equity Partners and Mubadala Capital.

key_facts.fact: Crusoe disclosed in June that it has contracts for nearly 5 gigawatts of computing power and more than 40 gigawatts in its total project pipeline.
key_facts.excerpt: Last month, Crusoe disclosed that it had contracts for nearly 5 gigawatts' worth of computing power and had more than 40 gigawatts in its total project pipeline.

key_facts.fact: Meta is under contract to buy computing capacity from Crusoe at two data centers in Childress, Texas, and Warrenton, Missouri; Crusoe also has deals with Microsoft, Google and Oracle.
key_facts.excerpt: Meta is under contract to buy computing capacity from Crusoe at two data centers in Childress, Texas, and Warrenton, Missouri... Crusoe also has deals with Microsoft Corp., Alphabet Inc.'s Google and Oracle.

key_facts.fact: Founded in 2018 to capture excess natural gas from energy fields to power crypto mining, Crusoe later pivoted to AI infrastructure.
key_facts.excerpt: Originally founded in 2018 as a business that captured excess natural gas from energy fields to power crypto-mining operation, Crusoe later shifted its focused to AI infrastructure.

stories.headline: IQM becomes first European quantum firm on a major US exchange in $1.9B Nasdaq SPAC debut

key_facts.fact: Finnish full-stack quantum company IQM went public on the Nasdaq on Thursday July 2 via a SPAC merger with Real Asset Acquisition Corp. at a valuation of about $1.9 billion, trading under ticker IQMX.
key_facts.excerpt: IQM, a full-stack quantum company out of Finland, went public on the Nasdaq Thursday via a SPAC merger at a valuation of about $1.9 billion. But share prices didn't pop.

key_facts.fact: IQM's American depositary shares fell about 95 cents (roughly 7.5%) early in the session before rebounding, and spent most of the day below the IPO price.
key_facts.excerpt: IQM Quantum Computers' American depositary shares began trading on the Nasdaq Global Select Market today (July 2, 2026), falling 95 cents, or about 7.5%, in early trading.

key_facts.fact: IQM is the first European quantum computing company to list on a major US stock exchange, entering the public markets with a pro forma cash position of about 337 million euros and 23 quantum computers sold worldwide.
key_facts.excerpt: IQM (Nasdaq: IQMX) maintains a strong pro forma cash position of EUR 337 million. The company enters the public markets... having sold 23 quantum computers worldwide, more than any other quantum manufacturer.

key_facts.fact: The combination and PIPE generated net proceeds of approximately 198 million euros ($226 million) for IQM, which had already raised $300 million in a Series B last September.
key_facts.excerpt: The operation will generate new liquidity for IQM — approximately EUR 198 million after costs, or $226 million. But the company had already raised $300 million last September.

key_facts.fact: IQM keeps its European center of gravity, also debuting on Nasdaq Helsinki, where it expects continued backing from Finland's sovereign wealth fund Tesi.
key_facts.excerpt: In parallel to its IQMX ticker in the U.S., it is due to debut tomorrow on Nasdaq Helsinki, where it expects continued support from the likes of Tesi, Finland's sovereign wealth fund.

stories.headline: Nvidia to backstop young cloud providers' GPUs in exchange for a cut of their revenue

key_facts.fact: Nvidia unveiled a revenue-sharing and credit-support model in which it earns both standard product revenue and a share of AI cloud providers' revenue on supported capacity.
key_facts.excerpt: AI clouds will sell NVIDIA-powered cloud services, with NVIDIA earning both standard product revenue and a share of the cloud revenue on the supported capacity... provides NVIDIA with a recurring, usage-linked earnings stream.

key_facts.fact: The program, known internally as the AI Compute Partnership, has Nvidia agreeing to rent back unused GPU capacity at a fixed rate if providers cannot find enough AI customers, in return for a share of revenue.
key_facts.excerpt: Nvidia would agree to rent back unused GPU capacity if these companies cannot find enough AI developers to use it. In return, Nvidia could receive a share of the cloud providers' revenue. The effort is reportedly known inside Nvidia as the AI Compute Partnership.

key_facts.fact: Sharon AI is deploying up to 40,000 Nvidia Grace Blackwell GB300 GPUs, and Firmus is building a DSX AI factory campus in Batam, Indonesia expected to scale to 360 megawatts and up to 170,000 Nvidia GPUs.
key_facts.excerpt: Sharon AI is deploying up to 40,000 NVIDIA Grace Blackwell GB300 GPUs. Firmus is building a DSX AI factory campus in Batam, Indonesia. The campus is expected to scale to 360 megawatts and up to 170,000 NVIDIA GPUs.

key_facts.fact: Developers receive token credits in exchange for a slice of their future sales, though Nvidia and its partners have not disclosed the revenue-split percentages.
key_facts.excerpt: Developers receive token credits in exchange for a slice of their future sales, but neither Nvidia nor its partners has disclosed the revenue-split percentages.

key_facts.fact: The model helps Nvidia reduce reliance on a small group of giant customers -- Amazon, Microsoft, Alphabet, Meta and Oracle -- several of which are building their own AI chips.
key_facts.excerpt: The program also gives Nvidia a way to reduce its reliance on a small group of giant customers, including Amazon, Microsoft, Alphabet, Meta Platforms, and Oracle.

stories.headline: Chip group SEMI urges US not to intervene in memory market as AI drives shortage

key_facts.fact: SEMI sent a letter dated July 1 to senior Trump administration officials arguing the government should not intervene directly in the memory chip market and should instead focus on expanding production.
key_facts.excerpt: The global industry association SEMI stated in a letter sent on July 1 (local time) to senior officials of the Donald Trump administration, 'Policies to enhance the resilience of domestic supply chains can be helpful, but interventions that distort prices or production capacity risk prolonging the shortage.'

key_facts.fact: SEMI warned that as high-bandwidth memory (HBM) production for AI data centers expands, general DRAM capacity is shrinking, worsening shortages across laptops, smartphones, automobiles, home appliances and defense.
key_facts.excerpt: SEMI diagnosed that as production of high-bandwidth memory (HBM) for AI data centers expands, general DRAM production capacity is decreasing, which is exacerbating memory supply shortages across a range of industries.

key_facts.fact: SEMI projected memory production capacity will grow about 19% per year on average but expects AI infrastructure demand to outpace that, keeping shortages and price pressure in place.
key_facts.excerpt: SEMI projected that memory production capacity will increase by about 19% per year on average, but the pace of AI infrastructure demand growth is expected to outstrip this.

key_facts.fact: The letter came as Apple asked the US government to let it procure memory from China's CXMT and YMTC to ease shortages; SEMI's members include Micron, Samsung, SK hynix, Intel and TSMC across 3,000-plus companies.
key_facts.excerpt: The letter came as Apple asked the U.S. government to cooperate so it can procure memory from China's CXMT and YMTC to ease shortages... With Micron in the United States, Samsung Electronics, and SK hynix all participating as members.

key_facts.fact: As alternatives to intervention, SEMI proposed working with Congress to expand long-term supply contracts, extend tax incentives for US production, and introduce consumer tax credits to offset rising phone and laptop prices.
key_facts.excerpt: SEMI believes that... allowing memory semiconductor companies to continue long-term contracts with customers and providing tax credits would alleviate price pressure.

stories.headline: Blackstone's QTS terminates Virginia's Digital Gateway, once slated to be world's largest data center

key_facts.fact: Blackstone subsidiary QTS said on Thursday July 2 that it had terminated its planned Digital Gateway data center project in Virginia and withdrawn the associated filings after years of planning and regulatory review.
key_facts.excerpt: Blackstone's QTS said on Thursday it had terminated its planned Digital Gateway data center project in Virginia and withdrawn the associated filings after years of planning and regulatory review.

key_facts.fact: QTS withdrew its appeal at the Virginia Supreme Court on July 2, the last developer standing after the Prince William County board and co-developer Compass had already dropped out.
key_facts.excerpt: While the Prince William County Board of Supervisors and co-developer Compass previously declined further appeals in April, QTS had pushed forward until filing its notice of withdrawal on July 2.

key_facts.fact: The 2,100-acre campus adjacent to Manassas National Battlefield Park would have been the largest data center complex in the world.
key_facts.excerpt: effectively terminating plans for a massive 2,100-acre data center complex adjacent to Manassas National Battlefield Park... which would have been the largest data center complex in the world.

key_facts.fact: The termination follows a March 31 Virginia Court of Appeals ruling that unanimously found Prince William County's rezoning of the project fundamentally flawed, voiding the approvals.
key_facts.excerpt: The legal resolution follows a March 31 ruling by the Virginia Court of Appeals, which unanimously agreed with a lower court that Prince William County's consideration of the data center rezoning was fundamentally flawed, thereby voiding the approvals.

key_facts.fact: QTS said the project would have delivered tens of billions of dollars in capital investment and thousands of jobs, and that Virginia remains a major part of its business, citing $5 billion in Central Virginia.
key_facts.excerpt: QTS said Virginia remains a major part of its business, citing investments in Northern Virginia and the Richmond region, including $5 billion in Central Virginia. The Digital Gateway project was expected to bring tens of billions of dollars in capital investment.

stories.headline: China clears Unitree's $618M Shanghai IPO, first humanoid robot maker to list on A-shares

key_facts.fact: China's securities regulator (CSRC) approved Unitree Robotics' STAR Market IPO registration on Thursday July 2, clearing the humanoid robot maker's final regulatory hurdle.
key_facts.excerpt: The China Securities Regulatory Commission said on Thursday that it had received the Shanghai Stock Exchange's review opinion and Unitree's registration documents, and approved the company's IPO registration.

key_facts.fact: Unitree plans to raise about 4.2 billion yuan ($618 million), to be channeled into robotics AI model research, new product development and expanded production capacity.
key_facts.excerpt: Unitree plans to raise about 4.2 billion yuan ($618 million) through the offering, which it will channel into robotics AI model research, new product development and expanded production capacity.

key_facts.fact: The clearance makes Unitree the first embodied AI company on track to list on China's A-share market.
key_facts.excerpt: The clearance hands Unitree its 'admission ticket' to become the first embodied AI company to list on China's A-share market.

key_facts.fact: Unitree's revenue surged 335% last year to 1.71 billion yuan and net profit climbed 204% to 287.6 million yuan, making it one of the few profitable firms in China's embodied AI sector.
key_facts.excerpt: Unitree's revenue surged 335 percent last year to 1.71 billion yuan, while net profit climbed 204 percent to 287.6 million yuan, making it one of the few profitable firms in China's embodied AI sector.

key_facts.fact: The Hangzhou-based company shipped about 5,500 humanoid robots last year, capturing 32.4% of the global market even as average selling prices fell 36%, and won approval 104 days after its March 20 filing -- the fastest since the STAR Market pre-review system launched.
key_facts.excerpt: The Hangzhou-based company shipped about 5,500 humanoid robots last year, capturing 32.4 percent of the global market... Its approval, coming 104 days later, marks the fastest review since the STAR Market's pre-review system launched.
